name: sl-benchmark-10m
description: SL-benchmark-10m is a large-scale supervised learning dataset containing roughly 10 million labeled examples intended for training and evaluating NLP models. It is designed to support a range of supervised tasks (classification, sequence labeling) and to enable experiments in scale, generalization, and fine-tuning. The dataset is primarily aimed at researchers needing a high-volume labeled corpus for model development and benchmarking.
reputation: A large, author-released dataset with limited but growing use in experimental NLP workflows; not yet a widely adopted standard benchmark.
